title: The Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act, 1999
full_text: The Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act, 1999 महाराष्ट्र संघटित गुन्हेगारी नियंत्रण अधिनियम, १९९९. Long Title: An Act to make special provisions for prevention and control of, and for coping with, criminal activity by organized crime syndicate or gang, and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Punishment for organised crime. Section 4. Power of Special Courts with respect to other offences. Section 8. Public Prosecutor. Section 9. Procedure and powers of Special Court. Section 10. Trial by Special Courts to have precedence. Certain confessions made to police officer to be taken into consideration. Section 19. Protection of witnesses. Section 20. Forfeiture and attachment of property. Section 21.
